Source: Post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PKDL) is a chronic, stigmatizing skin condition occurring frequently after apparent clinical cure from visceral leishmaniasis.
Luganda: Post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PKDL) bulwadde bwa lukonziba obukwata olususu obutera okukwata abalwadde abawonye obulwadde bwa visceral leishmaniasis.
Yoruba: Post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PKDL) àìsàn àwọ̀ ara ọlọ́jọ́ pípẹ́ tí ó ń fa àdẹ́yesí tí ó ń ṣẹlẹ̀ lóòrè-kóòrè lẹ́yìn ìwòsàn àrùn lesimaníásíìsì onímọ̀lára fìsẹ́rà.
Zulu: i-Post-akala-azar dermal leishmaniasisi (PKDL) isifo samahlalakhona, isimo esilulazayo sesikhumba esenzeka njalo emva kokulashwa ngaphakathi kwe-leishmaniasis.
Hausa: Ƙurajen fuska rututu (PKDL) wani ciwo ne mai tsanani, mai sa ƙyamaar fata wanda yake faruwa akai-akai bayan bayyanar magani daga baƙin zazzaɓi na kayan ciki.
Northern Sotho: Post-kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PKDL) ke bolwetši bja go se alafege, bja sepoulo bja mathata a letlalo bjo bo hlagago kgafetšakgafetša ka morago ga go hwetša kalafo ya visceral leishmaniasis.
Amharic: ፖስት-ካላ-አዛር የቆዳ ቀንጭር (ፖ.ካ.አ.ቆ.ቀ) ስር የሰደደ፣ አግላይ እና ከውሳጤ ቀንጭር በክሊኒክ ህክምና መዳን ከታየ በኋላ እንኳ በተደጋጋሚ የሚከሰት የቆዳ ሁኔታ ነው፡፡

Source: Given an urgent need for new treatments, we conducted a phase IIa safety and immunogenicity trial of ChAd63-KH vaccine in Sudanese patients with persistent PKDL.
Luganda: Engeri gye waliwo obwetaavu obw’obujjanjabi obupya, twakola okugezesa eddagala mu kitundu IIa erigema ChAd63-KH okulaba obukuumi n’obutanuzi bwalyo mu balwadde b’e Sudan abalina PKDL anyiikidde.
Yoruba: Nípa pé ìlò kíákíá wà fún ìwòsàn tuntu, a ṣe ìṣedánwò ojú Iia ààbò àti àjèjì adáralóró ti abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára ChAd63-KH lára àwọn aláìsàn Sudan tí wọ́n ní PKDL lemọ́lemọ́.
Zulu: Njengoba kunesidingo esiphuthumayo sokwelasha.Senze isigaba se-IIa sokuhlola nokusebenza komgomo i-ChAd63-KH kwiziguli zase-Sudan ngale-PKDL ephikelelayo.
Hausa: Ganin buƙatar gaggawa don sababbin magunguna, mun gudanar da gwajin aminci da rigakafi na lokaci IIa na maganin ChAd63-KH a cikin majiyyata na Sudan tare da ci gaba da PKDL.
Northern Sotho: Ka mabaka a nyakego ya potlako ya go hwetša dikalafo tše mpsha, re dirile diteko tša legato la IIa tša polokego le tša tšhireletšo ya mašole a mmele tša moento wa ChAd63-KH go balwetši ba Sudan bao ba nago le PKDL ye e sa folego.
Amharic: አዳዲስ ህክምናዎች በአስቸኳይ ከማስፈለጋቸው አኳያ፣ ተደጋጋሚ፣ ፖ.ካ.አ.ቆ.ቀ ባለባቸው ሱዳናዊ ታካሚዎች የChAd63-KH ክትባት የIIa ደረጃ የደህነት እና በሽታን የመካላከል ችሎታ ሙከራን አድርገናል፡፡

Source: LEISH2a (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02894008) was an open-label three-phase clinical trial involving sixteen adult and eight adolescent patients with persistent PKDL (median duration, 30 months; range, 6– 180 months).
Luganda: LEISH2a (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02894008) kwali kugezesa ddagala okwakolebwa mu mitendera esatu ng’abasawo n’abalwadde bamanyi bulungi eddagala erigezesebwa okwalimu abantu abakulu kkumi na mukaaga n’abalwadde abavubuka munaana abalina PKDL anyiikidde (ebbanga erya wakati, emyezi 30; ekiseera ekikolebwamu, emyezi 6-180).
Yoruba: LEISH2a (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02894008) jẹ́ ìsedá́nwò ajẹmọ́wòsàn tí àwọn àgbàlagbà mẹ́rìndínlógún àti àwọn ọ̀dọ́ mẹ́jọ tí wọ́n jẹ́ aláìsàn tí ó ní PKDL lemọ́lemọ́ kópa (agbedeméjì àkókò, oṣù 30; ìgbèdéke, oṣù 6-180).
Zulu: i-LEISH2a (ClinicalTrial.gov: NCT02894008) bekuyilebuli evulelekile yokuhlolwa komtholampilo kwisigaba sesithathu okubandakanya kuso abantu abadala abayishumi nesithupha kanye nabayisishangalombili abancane abanesifo se-PKDL (meubude besikhathi esimaphakathi, izinyanga ezingama-30; ububanzi, izinyanga eziyi-6-180).
Hausa: LEISH2a (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT02894008) buɗaɗɗen lakabin gwaji ne na asibiti wanda ya haɗa da manya guda goma sha shida da majiyyata guda takwas tare da PKDL mai tsayi (matsakaicin lokaci, watanni 30; iyaka, watanni 6 zuwa 180).
Northern Sotho: LEISH2a (ClinicalTrials.gov:  NCT02894008) e be e le diteko tšeo bakgathatema ba tsebago ka sehlare seo ba se fiwago, tša magato a mararo tše di amago balwetši ba batho ba bagolo ba lesometshela le bafsa ba seswai bao ba swerwego ke PKDL ye e sa folego (pakanako ya magareng, dikgwedi tše 30; go tloga go, dikgwedi tše 6– 180).
Amharic: LEISH2a (ክሊኒካዊ ሙከራዎች gov:  NCT02894008) ክፍት-መለያ ሶስት-ደረጃ ያለው ክሊኒካዊ ሙከራ ተደጋጋሚ፣ ፖ.ካ.አ.ቆ.ቀ (አማካይ ቆይታ 30 ወራት ፣ መጠን፣ ከ6– 180 ወራት) ያለባቸውን አስራ ስድስት አዋቂዎች እና ስምንት ታዳጊ ወጣት ታካሚዎችን ያካተተ ነበር፡፡

Source: Patients received a single intramuscular vaccination of 1 X 1010 viral particles (v.p.; adults only) or 7.5 X 1010 v.p. (adults and adolescents), with primary (safety) and secondary (clinical response and immunogenicity) endpoints evaluated over 42–120 days follow-up.
Luganda: Abalwadde baagemebwa omulundi gumu eddagala erigemebwa mu binywa eririmu patiko z’akawuka 1 X 1010 (v.p.; abakulu bokka) oba 7.5 X 1010 v.p. (abakulu n’abavubuka), eririna obukuumi awamu n’obutanuzi bw’obutaffaali obulwanyisa endwadde eryakeberebwa era ne lirondoolwa mu bbanga lya nnaku eziri wakati wa 42-120.
Yoruba: Àwọn aláìsàn gba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára sínú iṣan ara lẹ́ẹ̀kanṣo tí ó jẹ́ 1 X 1010 viral particles (v.p.; àwọn àgbàlagbà nìkan) tàbí 7.5 X 1010 v.p. (àwọn àgbàlagbà àti àwọn ọ̀dọ́) pẹ̀lú ìpìlẹ̀ (ààbò) àti ìkejì (ìtakìjí ajẹmọ́wòsàn àti àjèjì adáralóró) tí wọ́n ṣàyẹ̀wò òpin wọn láàrin ọjọ́ 42-120 fún ìtọ̀lẹ́yìn.
Zulu: Iziguli zithole ukugoma okukodwa okumayelana nobulili ye-1 X 1010 yamaqembu amagciwane (v.; abadala kuphela) noma 7.5 X 1010 v.p. (abadala nabancane), aba (nokuphepha) okuqavile kanye nokwesibili (nempendulo yomtholampilo kanye nokusebenza kwekhambi) amaphuzu okugcina ahlole ngaphezulu kwama-42-120 wezinsuku zokulandelela.
Hausa: Majiyyata sun karɓi allurar rigakafi guda ɗaya na ƙwayoyin cuta na 1 X 1010 (v.p.; manya kawai) ko 7.5 X 1010 v.p. (manya da matasa), tare da (aminci) na farko da na biyu (amsar maganin asibiti da garkuwar jiki) da aka kimanta a kan biyo-baya na kwanaki 42- zuwa 120.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba hlabetšwe moento o tee mošifeng wa 1 X 1010 tša dikarolwana tša baerale (v.p.; batho ba bagolo fela) goba 7.5 X 1010 v.p. (batho ba bagolo le bafsa), ka dintlha tša motheo (polokego) le tša tlaleletšo (kabo ya diteko tša kalafo le tšhireletšo ya mašole a mmele) tše di lekotšwego go tekolo ya seemo ya matšatši a 42–120.
Amharic: ታካሚዎች1 X 1010 የቫይረስ ቅንጣቶች (ቫ.ቅ አዋቂዎች ብቻ) ወይም 7.5 X 1010 ቫ.ቅ ያሉት አንድ የጡንቻ ውስጥ ክትባት ወስድዋል፡፡ (አዋቂዎች እና ታዳጊ ወጣቶች) በመጀመሪያ (በደህንነት) ሁለተኛ ደግሞ (በክሊኒካዊ ምላሽ እና በሽታን በመከላከል ችሎታ) የመጨረሻ ነጥቦች፣ ከ42–120 ቀናት በላይ ክትትልን ገምግመዋል፡፡

Source: AmBisome was provided to patients with significant remaining disease at their last visit.
Luganda: AmBisome yaweebwa abalwadde abaali bakyalina obulwadde obwa waggulu omulundi gwe baasembayo okujja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n pèsè Ábísóòmù fún àwọn aláìsàn tí àìsàn ara wọn ṣì nípá lásìkò tí wọ́n se àbẹ̀wò gbẹ̀yìn.
Zulu: I-AmBosime yanikewa iziguli ezinezifo eziblulekile ezisele emzimbeni yazo.
Hausa: An ba da AmBisome ga majiyyata tare da sauran cututtukan da suka rage a ziyararsu ta ƙarshe.
Northern Sotho: AmBisome e filwe balwetši bao ba nago le bolwetši bjo bo bego bo sa šaletše mmeleng go ketelo ya bona ya mafelelo.
Amharic: በመጨረሻ በጉብኝታቸው ወቅት ጉልህ የሆነ ቀሪ በሽታ ለነበረባቸው ታካሚዎች አምቢሶም ተሰጥቷቸዋል፡፡

Source: ChAd63-KH vaccine showed minimal adverse reactions in PKDL patients and induced potent innate and cell-mediated immune responses measured by whole-blood transcriptomics and ELISpot.
Luganda: Eddagala erigema erya ChAd63-KH lyalaga obukosefu butono mu balwadde ba PKDL era ne butanula obusobozi bw’omubiri okulwanyisa endwadde obuzaale awamu n’obwo obutanulwa obutaffaali obupimibwa mu ndagabutonde zonna ezisangibwa mu musaayi awamu ne ELISpot.
Yoruba: Abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára ChAd63-KH kò fi gbogbo ara ja àwọn aláìsàn tí wọhn ní PKDL lára ó sì ṣokùnfà hóró aṣedáàbòbò tí wọ́n ṣe òsùwọ̀n rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú ẹ̀jẹ̀ ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ mólékù nínú hóró àti ELISpot.
Zulu: Umgomo i-ChAd63-KH iveze ukusabela okuncane ezigulini ze-PKDL futhi imithi enamandla engena ezakhini zomzimba kwase kukalwa ukugiqika kwamasosha omzimba nge whole-blood transcriptomics ne-ELISpot.
Hausa: Alurar maganin ChAd63-KH ya nuna ƙarancin halaye marasa kyau a cikin majiyyata na PKDL kuma ya haifar da na asali mai ƙarfi da amsa na rigakafi da aka auna ta hanyar nazarin ƙwayoyi a cikin sel na jini da kuma ELISpot.
Northern Sotho: Moento wa ChAd63-KH o bontšhitše ditlamorago tše nnyane tša kalafo go balwetši ba PKDL le go tsenya tlhago ye e fokotšwago le boitšhireletšo bja mmele bjo bo laolwago ke disele tše di elwago ke theransekhripthomikese tša madi ka moka le ELISpot.
Amharic: ChAd63-KH ክትባት በ ፖ.ካ.አ.ቆ.ቀ ታካሚዎች ላይ አነስተኛ አሉታዊ ምላሾችን አሳይቷል፤ እንዲሁም በሙሉ -የደም ትራንስክሪፕቶሚክስ እና ELISpot የተለካ ሃይለኛ ውስጣዊ እና ሴልን ማእከል ያደረገ የመከላከል ምላሾችን አመንጭቷል፡፡

Source: 7/23 patients (30.4%) monitored to study completion showed >90% clinical improvement, and 5/23 (21.7%) showed partial improvement.
Luganda: Abalwadde 7/23 (30.4%) abaalondoolwa okutuusa okunoonyereza we kwaggweera baayoleka enkyukakyuka ya bitundu >90% oluvannyuma lw’obujjanjabi, ate 5/23 (21.7%) ne balaga nti bafunyeemu enkyukakyuka ntono.
Yoruba: 7/23 àwọn aláìsàn (30.4%) ìmójútó iṣẹ́ ìwádìí fi hàn >90% ìgbèrú ajẹmọ́wòsàn, àti 5/23 (21.7%) fi ìgbèrú apá kan hàn.
Zulu: 7/23 weziguli (30.4%) ukuqashwa ukuze kuqedwe ucwaningo kuveze >90% ukuthuthuka kwezemtholampilo, futhi 5/23 (21.7%) ikhombise ukungathuthuki ngokuphelele.
Hausa: 7/23 cikin majiyyata (kashi 30.4%) da aka kula da su har kammala nazarin sun nuna>90% na haɓakar magani, kuma 5/23 (21.7%) ya nuna inganta kaɗan.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba 7/23 (30.4%) bao ba bego ba beilwe leihlo gore ba phethe dinyakišišo ba laeditše >90% tša kaonafalo go diteko tša kalafo, mola ba 5/23 (21.7%) ba laeditše kaonafalo ya seripa.
Amharic: እስከ ጥናቱ ፍጻሜ ክትትል የተደረገላቸው 7/23 ታካሚዎች (30.4%)>90% ክሊኒካዊ መሻሻልን አሳይተዋል እንዲሁም 5/23 (21.7%) የሚሆኑት ከፊል መሻሻል አሳይተዋል፡፡

Source: A logistic regression model applied to blood transcriptomic data identified immune modules predictive of patients with >90% clinical improvement.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gw’emigabanyo gy’ebivuddemu ogwakozesebwa ku bubaka obukwata ku ndagabutonde z’omu musaayi gwazuula obusobozi bw’omubiri okulwanyisa endwadde obwoleka abalwadde abalina enkyukakyuka ya bitundu >90%.
Yoruba: Àwòse ajẹmọ́ṣìrò kan tí wọ́n gbé lórí dátà ìmọ̀ ẹ̀kọ́ mólékù nínú hóró èjẹ̀ tí ó rí àwọn módù asàsọtẹ́lè àwọn aláìsàn >90% fún ìgbèrú ajẹmọ́wòsàn.
Zulu: I-logistic regression model yasetshenziswa kwi-blood transcriptomic data ehlonze ukubikezela komzimba kwiziguli ezithuthuke ngama >90%.
Hausa: Samfurin koma bayar dabaru da aka yi amfani da shi ga nazarin ƙwayoyin a cikin sel na bayanan jini sun gano nau'o’in rigakafi na tsinkayar majiyyata tare da haɓakar magani>90%.
Northern Sotho: Mmotlolo wa poelomorago wa lotšistiki wo o dirišwago go datha ya theransekhripthomike ya madi ye e hlaotšego dimotšule tša boitšhireletšo ya mmele go balwetši ka >90% tša kaonafatšo ya diteko tša kalafo.
Amharic: በደም ትራንስክሪፕቶሚክስ መረጃ ላይ የተተገበረ ሎጂስቲካዊ የምልሰት ሞዴል በ>90% ታካሚዎች ክሊኒካዊ መሻሻልን የሚተነብዩ የመከላከል ሞጁሎችን ለይቶ አውጥቷል፡፡

Source: A randomized controlled trial to determine whether these clinical responses were vaccine-related and whether ChAd63-KH vaccine has clinical utility is underway.
Luganda: Okugezesa okw’okweroboza kugenda mu maaso okuzuula oba ng’ebyo ebyavaamu oluvannyuma lw’obujjanjabi byali byekuusa ku ddagala erigema awamu n’okukakasa oba ng’eddagala lya ChAd63-KH erigema lirina omugaso mu kuvumula endwadde.
Yoruba: Ìṣedánwò àṣàyàn onídarí láti ṣe ìpinnu bóyá àwọn èsì ajẹmọ́wòsàn yìí nííse pẹ̀lú abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára àti pé bóyá abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára ChAd63-KH tí ó ṣe é lò fún ìṣèwòsàn ti wà lọ́nà.
